gizmo.title: Bullet check list
gizmo.description: A list of checkboxes. Readers tick items off and their progress is remembered on their own device.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: Name of the list. Read aloud as the label of the group of checkboxes.

configure.title: Items
configure.description: Each item is a checkbox. Checked or disabled items can not be changed by readers.

properties.title: Disabled
properties.description: Shown but readers can not change it.

configure.title: Numbered
configure.description: Show a numbered list instead of a bulleted one.

configure.title: Status
configure.description: Changes the colors to match stop-note.

advanced.title: Storage id
advanced.description: Unique id used to remember reader progress on their device. Generated automatically; change only to share progress between lists or to start fresh.
